query.identity: Dataset source ID + indicator code + ISO3 country code + annual period; dataset lastupdated and response hash identify mutable snapshot, not an immutable item revision.
query.paging: Documented page/per_page; research maximum10rows per request,256KiBbody, no bulk export or rate stress.

licensing: General data terms default CC BY4.0 with mandatory additional terms, source/provider attribution and third-party exceptions. All five selected public indicator pages explicitly label CC BY-4.0. Metadata source organizations and limitations remain separate from publication-repository content rights.
limitations: No full-source or civic-cell qualification from these samples.
WDI is an attributed aggregator; its original providers and71 listed API datasets do not become separately qualified origins.
Empty units must be interpreted with indicator name/definition; no units or missing values are invented.
USA/India data coverage is not independent network-vantage verification.
next_action: Continue chart/table accessibility and year/scaling review, provider attribution URI mapping, broader relevance and refresh/revision operations. Representative rendered charts passed with non-blocking CORS widget failure preserved.

identity_and_duplicates.summary: One World Bank WDI indicator catalog. Native observation identity includes dataset source, indicator, ISO3 country and annual period; mutable update dates and capture hashes identify the observed snapshot.

facts.version: API v2; all ten current observations report dataset lastupdated 2026-10-08, period 2023. These are not 2026 observations.
facts.deduplication: The same NY.GDP.MKTP.CD code appears in sources 2 and 11; source identity must not be omitted. Countries, periods, languages and dataset labels are not origins.
facts.operator_overlap: world-bank-okr is a separate publication repository record under the same World Bank operator. No independent-origin or common-content-license inference from separate records.
facts.attribution_chain: WDI aggregates original providers; references to UN, Eurostat, OECD and national agencies are leads and attribution, not independently qualified origins.

coverage_and_languages.summary: Verified scope is five English-labelled annual national indicators for India and the USA. This is statistical-data coverage, not country-specific network access or comprehensive civic coverage.

data_definitions.population: Midyear de facto estimates, not a household/person listing.
data_definitions.urban_share: National definitions, collected and smoothed by UN Population Division; not a uniform urban boundary definition.

facts.cell_closure: P08 USA/India have query evidence but remain unaccounted pending full qualification and coverage review.

query_contract.summary: Anonymous documented v2 GET requests passed ten native country/indicator/year cases. Metadata, data, empty responses and application errors have different shapes.

facts.shape: [page_header, observation_array]; country/source/indicator/year are checked; unit, status, decimal and footnote are retained verbatim.
facts.empty: Year 2200 returned total=0, pages=0, null source/update and null items. Initial strict parse failure and later offline interpretation are both retained.
facts.error: Unknown indicator returns HTTP 200 with message id 120 (Invalid value), not an empty success.
facts.null: A USA literacy 2023 record has value=null. It is preserved but never passes a numeric example; zero would remain a valid number.

rights_and_cost.summary: Selected indicator pages explicitly display CC BY 4.0. World Bank data terms additionally require provider attribution and mediation/arbitration terms; broader website and third-party rights remain separate.

facts.metadata_rights: Retain WDI indicator metadata/source organizations and attribution under the specific data policy; no blanket right to website chrome, trademarks or unrelated archives.
facts.data_rights: Five reviewed indicator pages label CC BY-4.0; default data policy has third-party exceptions and binding additional terms.
facts.attribution: The World Bank: World Development Indicators: original data source(s) from each indicator metadata. Preserve terms URL and applicable additional conditions.
facts.access_cost: Official API documentation states no API key/authentication needed; anonymous requests passed. No numeric quota or unlimited-service guarantee found.
facts.legal_redirect: Older datasets terms URL returned 301 to current generic terms; both attempts preserved. Generic website restrictions must be read with the specific data exception.

reader_access.summary: Two current World Bank country indicator pages render charts and selected-country metadata anonymously on desktop/mobile; all five public indicator pages and ten small numeric records are captured. Non-blocking widget and accessibility defects remain explicit.

facts.full_record_scope: Each retained JSON record contains the native indicator/country/year, numeric value and returned footnote/status metadata; no microdata or bulk export.
facts.network_vantage: Managed cloud, country not established; country-code filters do not prove USA/India reader vantage.

facts.visual_review: India GDP desktop line chart and USA population mobile chart visible. Cookie notice obscures bottom of viewport; no dismissal/account/location action taken. Charts show current2025 values, while the separately verified API examples select2023.
facts.new_error: Both reader loads reported a provider trustfunds.worldbank.org/portal/tfsearch CORS/403 widget error. Charts remained visible. No direct request or bypass was attempted; future browser checks should suppress known blocked widget requests rather than retry them.

open_questions: Assess data-chart/table keyboard and screen-reader access; both observed pages expose zero main landmarks and a cookie banner obscures the lower viewport.
Reconcile current-reader year/scaling presentation with exact API record links; do not compare2025 display values to2023 query examples as if same period.

quality_and_relevance.summary: Ten non-null native observations pass. Paging, same-code/different-source identity, unavailable periods, null values and HTTP-200 errors are preserved as separate checks.

facts.units: API unit is empty for all five indicators; indicator name/definition explains units. Do not manufacture an API unit field.
facts.semantic_relevance: Exact country/indicator/year selection, not natural-language semantic search. Population and urban definitions are estimates and depend on provider definitions.
facts.provider_metadata_anomaly: Population metadata labels Eurostat Demographic Statistics but links node_code=earn_ses_monthly. Preserve the exact URI as provider-supplied and keep its dataset mapping unresolved.
negative_tests: Invalid indicator HTTP200 is not an empty success
Year2200 empty response does not establish future availability

upstream_uri_followup.finding: Captured public Eurostat database shell describes datasets/flags but does not identify a selected population dataset in returned text. The earn_ses_monthly demographic attribution mapping remains unresolved.
upstream_uri_followup.constraint: Display exact World Bank-provided attribution as supplied; do not normalize this link into a verified demographic dataset, infer an upstream join or replace it with a guessed URI.

open_questions: Resolve or explicitly constrain the provider-supplied Eurostat demographic URI mismatch before claiming complete attribution mapping.
Review broader user-intent relevance and revision/withdrawal behavior outside these ten exact lookups.

operating_limits.summary: Research uses serial policy-checked, bounded metadata/data requests and stops on transport/access failures; no paid account, bulk export or rate testing.

facts.paging: Two explicit pages, source=2, per_page=2, four distinct country/year records.
facts.update_identity: Mutable dataset lastupdated and response hash; no immutable edition inferred.
facts.robots_policy_evidence: Saved per-host policy response hashes and request observations; a future denial must stop new requests.

open_questions: Define and rehearse bounded metadata/data refresh, deletion/revision handling and later-day reliability; do not infer unlimited access from absent numeric quota.

decision_and_followup.summary: Retain as a query-verified statistics candidate with ten current examples. Full source/area/jurisdiction qualification and runtime activation are open.

facts.revisit_trigger: Useful published policy/metadata changes or a new bounded qualification check; no access-denial bypass.
